summary: Showcase of a full Shadow team against the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque (Phase 1), achieving over 1.28 billion total damage. Seyir serves as the primary damage dealer, dishing out over 812 million damage. The video details hero gear setups, stats, and ultimate skill timing sequences. For players lacking Saverio, Daphne is recommended as an effective 1-to-1 substitute.

heroes.name: Seyir
heroes.note: Accounted for over 63% of the team's total damage against Mekkatorque, outputting 812M damage.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Contributed Necrosis damage and Bloodmoon Power; can be substituted if unavailable.

heroes.name: Daphne
heroes.note: Can replace Saverio against Mekkatorque and achieve a very similar score.

heroes.name: The Dark Lady
heroes.note: Provides Necrosis debuffs and strips shields while buffing allies.

heroes.name: Astaion
heroes.note: Provides healing, control effects, and supportive Necrosis damage.

heroes.name: Giacosa
heroes.note: Buffs Shadow allies with ultimate casts while maintaining steady Necrosis output.

teams.note: Full Shadow Necrosis composition scoring over 1.28B damage. Daphne can replace Saverio without major score loss.

tips: Skill timings for Mekkatorque: Seyir 12.0s first cast / 15.0s recast; Giacosa 11.8s first cast / 15.0s recast; Astaion 11.0s first cast / 15.0s recast; The Dark Lady 11.4s first cast / 30.0s recast; Saverio on Default.
If you lack Saverio, substitute Daphne directly into the team lineup for comparable performance.
